title_en: Chemistry common-sense dictionary over curated KRAS G12D Top-24 candidates
title_zh: 策展 KRAS G12D Top-24 候选的化学常识词典
truth_boundary_en: Computed structural and physicochemical description from RDKit only. Not binding, affinity, efficacy, safety, or developability evidence.
truth_boundary_zh: 仅由 RDKit 计算的结构与理化描述。不构成结合、亲和力、疗效、安全性或可开发性证据。

aggregates.inchi_key_note_en: InChIKey in this dictionary is recomputed from MolFromSmiles(canonical_smiles). When canonical_smiles omits stereo, the key can differ from the stereo-aware input_inchi_key.

smiles_reproducibility.method_en: For each candidate: m=MolFromSmiles(canonical_smiles); s1=MolToSmiles(m); s2=MolToSmiles(MolFromSmiles(s1)). Round-trip OK iff s1==s2.
